

# sehtest.exe is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sehtest-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# User-mode SEH boot self-test (crash-value lane) — the userland sibling of
# ntoskrnl/seh_poc.c. Compiled with REAL clang native SEH (-fms-extensions).
# i386's frame-based lowering is MSVC-env-only (the gnu target fails with
# L__ehtable$ — dummy-pseh-verdict.md §C), so there it is retargeted to
# i686-pc-windows-msvc the way the kmtests are, and _except_handler3 /
# _local_unwind2 come from libpseh.a's real i386/seh.s. Spawned by userinit at
# boot; prints [SEH-USER] … PASS/FAIL on the kernel debug serial.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(sehtest_shims OBJECT sehtest.c)
target_link_libraries(sehtest_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_options(sehtest_shims PRIVATE -fms-extensions)
if(ARCH STREQUAL "i386")
    target_compile_options(sehtest_shims PRIVATE --target=i686-pc-windows-msvc -fasync-exceptions)
endif()
add_cargo_module(sehtest sehtest-cargo sehtest.exe
    KIND win32exe
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS sehtest_shims)
